title: Understanding Variance
text: Variance in a model refers to how much the model's predictions change when using different training data. Adding random features can affect this. Think about how randomness might influence the model's stability.

title: Impact of Random Features
text: Consider what happens when you add a feature that doesn't have a real relationship with the target variable. How might this affect the model's ability to generalize to new data?

title: Evaluating the Statement
text: Does adding a feature of random numbers between $$0$$ and $$1$$ decrease variance?
